note: Example data: an invented three-location express car wash and invented rivals, not real businesses. Reviewer names were dropped when the rows were read, as the skill does. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "review-insights-analyzer" skill. Analyze the last 12 months of Google reviews for our three car wash locations. What drives our 1-star and 5-star reviews, is anything getting worse, and what should we fix first? Here are Rival A's last 30 reviews too.

business.name: Example Car Wash
business.type: express car wash with an unlimited membership

sources.own_reviews: Google Business Profile get_reviews, one call per location, rows in the window only
sources.rival_listings: DataForSEO business_listings_search, one call (category car wash, 8 km around the three locations)
sources.rival_reviews: Rival A's 30 most recent Google reviews in the window, pasted by the user
